text: This solution, Future Drought Fund (FDF) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Australia between Australian Government's Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry (DAFF), Regional Investment Corporation, State/Territory governments, Foundation for Rural & Regional Renewal (FRRR), Australian Rural Leadership Foundation (ARLF), and Universities and partners delivering Drought Resilience Adoption and Innovation Hubs. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration, raising awareness, and accessibility.
